title: Do Expressions Change Decisions? Exploring the Impact of AI’s Explanation Tone on Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing correlations between user age and changes in decision-making scores across different AI explanation tones in movie recommendation, opinion formation, and recidivism prediction tasks.
Conducting two-way ANOVA to evaluate the interaction between user gender and AI explanation tones on the differences in users' decision-making scores.
Examining correlations between users' Big Five personality traits and their decision-making score differences when exposed to various AI explanation tones.
